title: Trail Running Poles: benefits, length and design
claims: For beginners, the ideal trail-running pole length can be calculated by multiplying height by 0.7; length also depends on personal preference and individual technique, and most professional athletes use longer poles.
Using poles relieves the legs and shifts part of the load to the upper body, while ground reaction and joint forces are reduced.

Most scientific results show a significant increase in oxygen demand, heart rate and energy expenditure when using poles; some studies indicate lower perceived intensity on steeper ascents and descents, with less muscle soreness and faster recovery observed.
